description_en: Creates an electricity load forecasting task with historical data from a file URL
description_zh: 创建用电负荷预测任务，历史数据来自文件url
kebab_example: aliyun brain-industrial create-load-forecast-by-file-url-job --device-type electricityMeter --history-url https://bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/dir/target_file.csv --freq FIFTEEN_MIN --duration 1 --system-type load --run-date 2025-01-01 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --model-version latest --business-key stationA --time-column runTime --value-column value --forecast-horizon DAY_AHEAD --data-mode FULL --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadForecastByFileUrlJob

parameters.description_en:
The device type. The device types supported by each system type are as follows: 

- load: electricityMeter (utility meter)
- hvac: gateway-hvac (air conditioner)
- flexible: electricityMeter (lighting meter)
- charge: gateway-charging (charging station).
parameters.description_zh:
设备类型，每个系统类型支持的设备类型有： 

- load: electricityMeter --市电电表
- hvac: gateway-hvac --空调
- flexible: electricityMeter --照明电表
- charge：gateway-charging --充电桩

parameters.description_en: The URL of the historical data CSV file. The URL must be publicly accessible during the call.

parameters.description_en:
The data frequency. The value must match the frequency of the historical data. Valid values:
- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes.
- FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes.
- ONE_HOUR: 1 hour.
- ONE_HOUR: 1 day.

Default value: FIFTEEN_MIN.
parameters.description_zh:
默认值为FIFTEEN_MIN；需要与历史数据的数据频率一致；
- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15分钟
- FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
- ONE_HOUR: 1小时
- ONE_DAY: 1天

parameters.description_en:
The data mode for this call. Valid values:
- FULL: full data. Only the data passed in this call is used.
- INCREMENTAL: incremental data. Data from previous calls with the same BusinessKey is automatically associated.
parameters.description_zh:

- FULL：全量数据（仅使用本次调用中传递的数据）
- INCREMENTAL：增量数据（自动关联使用历史调用中相同BusinessKey的数据）
